// 節錄自 MVDIS webpickno 頁面（2026-10-26 抓取）：chkForm() 原始碼，供測試解析 alert 字串與驗證欄位規則。
function chkForm() {
	if(document.getElementById('selDeptCode').value == '0' || document.getElementById('selStationCode').value == '0'){
		alert('請選擇管轄監理單位');
		return false;
	}
	if(document.getElementById('selWindowNo').value == '0'){
		alert('請選擇領牌地點');
		return false;
	}
	if(!document.getElementById('selCarType').value){
		alert('請選擇車種別');
		return false;
	}
	if(document.getElementById('selEnergyType').value == '0'){
		alert('請選擇能源別');
		return false;
	}
	if(document.getElementById('selPlateType').value == '0'){
		alert('請選擇車牌別');
		return false;
	}
	if (dwr.util.getValue('plateVer') == '') {
		alert('請選擇車牌樣式');
		return false;
	}
	document.WebPickNoForm.action ="/m3-emv-plate/webpickno/queryPickNo#anchor";
	document.WebPickNoForm.method.vlaue='qryPickNo';
	var radioObj = document.getElementsByName('queryType');
	for(var i=0; i<radioObj.length; i++) {
		if(radioObj[i].checked){
			if(radioObj[i].value == '2' && document.getElementById('queryNo').value.length == 0) {
				alert('請輸入查詢號碼');
				return false;
			}
			if(radioObj[i].value == '1'){
			    document.WebPickNoForm.action ="/m3-emv-plate/webpickno/queryPickNo#anchor";
			    document.WebPickNoForm.method.value='qryLastNo';
			}
			else {
				if(radioObj[i].value == '0') {
					dwr.util.setValue('queryNo', '*');
				}
			}
		}
	}	
	
	if(dwr.util.getValue('validateStr') == '') {
		alert('請輸入驗證數字');
		return false;
	}
	
	return true;
}
